label: KBDU Reconstruction V2 Quest runtime HLOD recipe
limitations: Static mesh and renderer-slot estimates do not establish measured draw calls or Quest performance.
The non-context baseline is inherited static evidence and must be refreshed after unrelated product changes.
Physical Quest timing, thermals, stereo stability, and comfort remain separate acceptance gates.

non_context_baseline.provenance: Actual Unity serialized scene evidence reports 99 non-context renderers (45 direct environment plus 54 aircraft) and 551958 non-context aggregate triangles after subtracting the authored 40-group context. These values are used conservatively as visible planning baselines.

non_context_serialized_baseline.provenance: Unity EditMode serialized scene measured 219 renderers and 685141 triangles; subtracting the authored 40-group/120-renderer, 133183-triangle context gives 99 renderers and 551958 triangles.
